installs: Four skill directories under plugins/framefields/skills/, each holding one SKILL.md: framefields (setup and first render), framefields-compose, framefields-effects (with an effects-catalog reference), and framefields-render. Two manifests wrap them for Claude Code: the root .claude-plugin/marketplace.json names one plugin, framefields, sourced at ./plugins/framefields, and plugins/framefields/.claude-plugin/plugin.json versions it 2.0.11 and also carries an OpenAI extensions block. The README installs with /plugin install framefields for Claude Code and, while plugin review is slow, directs every other agent to npx skills add gatewai-dev/framefields, naming Codex, Cursor, Hermes, Gemini CLI, and Copilot; Hermes has no host value in the taxonomy so it is not recorded. The installed tree holds no program: no hooks, servers, scripts, or state.
distribution_machinery: None. The installed tree holds four SKILL.md documents, one reference file, two JSON manifests, and two copies of one licence file; there is no install script, hook, server, or other program.
not_a_system: Owns no state it reads back and does no enforced work: everything the skills cause — scaffolding, composing, rendering, QA — is done by the host agent and the SDK in the user's own project following documents, and the five-step verification ladder is advisory process, not a blocking gate. The framefields npm SDK and WebGPU renderer the documents drive are product code outside the installed pack, not pack-owned state.
license_note: Repository LICENCE file, duplicated byte-identical inside the plugin directory; head, tail, and a scan for revenue, attribution-gate, and separate-agreement terms show the unmodified Apache-2.0 text with no addenda.

license_evidence.scope: Repository LICENCE file, duplicated unchanged inside the plugin directory
